description: This file defines the ClaimEvent entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing claim-related events with properties like id, name, description, user, status, and deletion flag, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ClaimEvent
classes.description: Entity class representing a claim event with properties, ORM mappings, and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the claim event.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the claim event.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the claim event.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the claim event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the claim event.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the claim event.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the claim event.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the claim event.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the claim event is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the claim event as deleted or not.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user who added the claim event.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user who added the claim event.
